lines.en: label cafe30:
scene cafe_day
I arrive at the cafe as if it’s any other day.
lines.zh: 我像平常任何一天那样走进咖啡馆。

lines.en: Everything is completely normal and the bubbly girl behind the counter is going to force me to drink her latest concoction.
lines.zh: 一切完全正常，柜台后面那个元气满满的姑娘会逼我喝下她最新的特调。

lines.en: We’ll chat for a bit and probably laugh about[school] and life or whatever else is on our minds.
lines.zh: 我们会聊上一会儿，大概还会笑着聊聊[school]啊、人生啊，或者脑子里随便想点什么。

lines.en: Rin will bring up her roommate and how she’s been in a much better mood as of late.
lines.zh: Rin 会提起她的室友，说她最近心情好多了。

lines.en: And then she’ll pick up her guitar from behind the counter and play the other customers and myself a song she wrote about getting over her first heartbreak.
lines.zh: 然后她会从柜台后面拿起吉他，给其他客人还有我弹一首她写的、关于走出第一次心碎的歌。

lines.en: It will be a wonderful day.
lines.zh: 那会是很美好的一天。

lines.en: scene postbeach1
Just kidding. Everything is horrible.
lines.zh: 开玩笑的。一切糟透了。
: Rin？……

lines.en: scene postbeach2
: Surprise!
lines.zh: : 惊喜！

lines.en: : Why were you hiding underneath the counter?
lines.zh: : 你为什么躲在柜台底下？

lines.en: scene postbeach3
: Uhh...probably because I look like I was hit by a bus.
lines.zh: : 呃……大概是因为我看起来像被巴士撞过吧。

lines.en: : You look fine. Just a little...tired.
lines.zh: : 你看起来挺好的。只是有点……累。

lines.en: scene postbeach4
: You’re just obligated to say that because you’re my friend.
lines.zh: : 你是因为是我朋友才不得不这么说的。

lines.en: : I looked in the mirror this morning. I know what I saw.
lines.zh: : 我今天早上照过镜子。我看见什么我自己清楚。

lines.en: scene postbeach3
: Crazy, right? Imagine reacting like this to something as simple as being rejected. Hahah...Hahahaha...
lines.zh: : 疯了吧？就因为被拒绝这么简单的事，反应成这样。哈哈……哈哈哈……

lines.en: : But...I guess that’s just how brains work sometimes.
lines.zh: : 不过……我想有时候大脑就是这么运作的吧。

lines.en: : You take one little thing and just blow it up and up and up until it’s way bigger than you.
lines.zh: : 你拿一件小事，然后把它越吹越大、越吹越大，直到它比你整个人还大。

lines.en: : Then, all of a sudden, POP!
lines.zh: : 然后，突然，啪！

lines.en: scene postbeach2
: I think, right now, I’m probably a few more pumps away from the popping stage.
lines.zh: : 我觉得，我现在大概再打几下气就要到炸开的阶段了。

lines.en: : So as long as I’m able to not keep pumping up the balloon, I should be able to get by. No sweat!
lines.zh: : 所以只要我别再继续给气球打气，我应该就能撑过去。小菜一碟！

lines.en: While her description of life is a bit childish, it’s not completely inaccurate.
lines.zh: 虽然她对人生的描述有点幼稚，但也不算完全不准。

lines.en: Learning how to deal with your problems is 10%% acceptance and 90%% damage control.
lines.zh: 学会处理自己的问题，10%% 是接受，90%% 是控制损失。

lines.en: Why try to fix anything when you can just consistently avoid it until it becomes a much smaller problem?
lines.zh: 明明可以一直回避，直到它变成一个小得多的问题，何必去修什么呢？

lines.en: The passage of time {s}heals{/s} fixes all.
lines.zh: 时间的流逝{s}治愈{/s}解决一切。

lines.en: : True, but I wouldn’t say “No sweat” when you look like you’re burning up.
lines.zh: : 是没错，不过你看起来像烧起来了一样，我可不会说「小菜一碟」。

lines.en: : Maybe you should take your hoodie off?
lines.zh: : 要不你把帽衫脱了吧？

lines.en: scene postbeach5
: B-But I like my hoodie! It’s...comfortable.
lines.zh: : 可、可是我喜欢我的帽衫！它……很舒服。

lines.en: : And it gets really cold in the kitchen.
lines.zh: : 而且厨房里真的很冷。

lines.en: : I don’t want to freeze when I go back there and wind up having to miss[school] or anything.
lines.zh: : 我回去的时候可不想冻僵，结果又得请假不去[school]什么的。

lines.en: : And you’re sure it’s not because you’re using it to hide something from me?
lines.zh: : 你确定不是因为你想用它藏点什么不让我看见？

lines.en: scene postbeach6
: Is that an accusation, Sensei?...
lines.zh: : 这是指控吗，Sensei？……

lines.en: : If that’s what you want to call it.
lines.zh: : 你想这么称呼也行。

lines.en: : You don’t exactly have the cleanest track record when it comes to {i}not{/i} hurting yourself.
lines.zh: : 在{i}不{/i}伤害自己这件事上，你的前科可算不上干净。

lines.en: : Harsh.
lines.zh: : 扎心了。

lines.en: : I told you on vacation that I was done with stuff like that, didn’t I?
lines.zh: : 我在度假的时候跟你说过，我已经不做那种事了，不是吗？

lines.en: : You did. But that was prior to you crying your eyes out for an entire night and vanishing before any of us even woke up.
lines.zh: : 你是说过。不过那是在你哭了整整一夜、然后在我们任何人醒来之前消失得无影无踪之前。

lines.en: scene postbeach7
: Well what else was I supposed to do?! Wake up and pretend nothing ever happened?!
lines.zh: : 那我还能怎么办？！醒来假装什么都没发生过吗？！

lines.en: : My eyes were friggin’ swollen from crying and I had a headache.
lines.zh: : 我眼睛都哭肿了，头也疼。

lines.en: : I wasn’t thinking clearly then and I’m not thinking clearly now either.
lines.zh: : 那时候我脑子不清楚，现在也不清楚。

lines.en: : What did Chika even say to you to make you want to avoid her so badly?
lines.zh: : Chika 到底跟你说了什么，让你这么想躲着她？

lines.en: scene postbeach8
: Uhh...well, I mean, she kind of...didn’t really say anything.
lines.zh: : 呃……嗯，我是说，她其实……也没真的说什么。

lines.en: : But I could tell from the look in her eyes that there was no chance of it ever happening.
lines.zh: : 但我从她的眼神里就能看出来，这事永远都不可能。

lines.en: : Then, before long I felt my head spinning.
lines.zh: : 然后没过多久，我就觉得脑袋天旋地转。

lines.en: : I kept thinking things about what it would be like to be with her.
lines.zh: : 我一直在想，跟她在一起会是什么样。

lines.en: : And how she might act when she’s alone with the person she loves.
lines.zh: : 还有她跟自己爱的人独处时，会是什么样子。

lines.en: scene postbeach2
: And then I thought of you...and how lucky you are to be able to catch the eye of someone as great as her.
lines.zh: : 然后我想到了你……想到你能被像她那么好的人看上，有多幸运。

lines.en: : What’s it like, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 那是什么感觉，Sensei？

lines.en: : Gaining the affection of others without ever really doing anything to {i}earn{/i} it?
lines.zh: : 不用真的{i}付出{/i}什么，就能得到别人的喜欢？

lines.en: : I can’t tell if you’re insulting me right now...
lines.zh: : 我分不清你现在是在骂我……

lines.en: scene postbeach9
: Not insulting you. Just an observation.
lines.zh: : 不是骂你。只是观察而已。

lines.en: : You’re very important to me as well but, in some way or another, I feel like you’ve {i}always{/i} been important to me.
lines.zh: : 你对我来说也很重要，但不知怎么的，我觉得你{i}一直{/i}都对我很重要。

lines.en: scene postbeach2
: I had a crazy dream the other night, Sensei. Do you want to hear about it?
lines.zh: : 前几天晚上我做了个很疯的梦，Sensei。想听听吗？

lines.en: : {s}No{/s} Yes.
lines.zh: : {s}不想{/s}想。

lines.en: scene postbeach9
: It was a dream of a new world.
lines.zh: : 那是一个关于新世界的梦。

lines.en: : Well, kind of.
lines.zh: : 嗯，算是吧。

lines.en: : It was the same world as this one. But it was one where we got to redo all of our mistakes.
lines.zh: : 还是同一个世界。只不过在那个世界里，我们可以把所有错误重来一遍。

lines.en: scene postbeach10
: Kind of like a reset button.
lines.zh: : 有点像重置按钮。

lines.en: scene postbeach2
: And in that world, after Chika rejected me, I just kept pressing the button over and over...
lines.zh: : 在那个世界里，Chika 拒绝我之后，我就一遍又一遍地按那个按钮……

lines.en: : And over and over and over and over and over and over and over and over and over and over and over and over until I found a world where she loved me!
lines.zh: : 一遍又一遍又一遍又一遍又一遍又一遍又一遍又一遍又一遍又一遍又一遍又一遍，直到我找到一个她爱我的世界！

lines.en: : It took a while, but it worked in the end. I also got to experience how good of a kisser she is.
lines.zh: : 花了点时间，不过最后成功了。我还体验到了她接吻的技术有多好。

lines.en: : It was really hot.
lines.zh: : 真的超性感。

lines.en: scene postbeach11
: But then, before any good stuff happened, I woke up.
lines.zh: : 可是，还没等发生什么好事，我就醒了。

lines.en: : How come dreams always end before we get to the saucy stuff?
lines.zh: : 为什么梦总是在我们刚要到那种火辣的部分就结束？

lines.en: : The kiss felt so real...I wanted to know what the things that come next felt like as well.
lines.zh: : 那个吻感觉太真实了……我也想知道接下来的事是什么感觉。

lines.en: if rinbetrayed == True:
scene postbeach6
: But I guess we can’t all be that lucky...can we, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 不过我想不是谁都能那么幸运吧……对吧，Sensei？

lines.en: : {i}You{/i} know what she feels like, don’t you?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}知道她是什么感觉，对吧？

lines.en: : Do you know how she tastes as well?
lines.zh: : 你也知道她尝起来是什么味道吗？

lines.en: : I bet it’s sweet...like candy.
lines.zh: : 我猜是甜的……像糖一样。

lines.en: scene postbeach12
: Hah...
: It’s so unfair...
lines.zh: : 太不公平了……

lines.en: : I woke up so hot, too...
lines.zh: : 我醒来的时候也好热……

lines.en: : I almost started rubbing up against you while you were asleep just to scratch the itch...but, you know.
lines.zh: : 我差点就在你睡着的时候蹭上去挠那个痒了……不过，你也知道的。

lines.en: scene postbeach10
: I remembered how you broke your promise to me and all of those naughty feelings just...went away.
lines.zh: : 我想起你违背了对我的承诺，于是那些下流的念头就……全没了。

lines.en: : Poof!
: Funny, right? Hahaha!
lines.zh: : 好笑吧？哈哈哈！

lines.en: else:
: But I guess there’s just no way that would ever happen...
lines.zh: : 不过我想那种事是永远不会发生在我身上的……

lines.en: : Not to me, at least.
lines.zh: : 至少不会是我。

lines.en: : All I can really do is hope that the dream comes back and I can press the button a few more times.
lines.zh: : 我真正能做的，也就只有盼着那个梦再回来，让我再多按几次按钮。

lines.en: : Okay, you know what? Why don't we talk about something happier?
lines.zh: : 好了，这样吧。我们聊点开心的事怎么样？

lines.en: : It might be best to just...get your mind off Chika entirely for a little while.
lines.zh: : 也许最好还是……让你暂时把 Chika 彻底忘掉。

lines.en: scene postbeach12
: Fiiiiine...
: But if this is one of those things where you try to pick me up on the rebound, I think I’m going to have to ask you to wait.
lines.zh: : 不过如果这是那种「趁虚而入」的把戏，我想我得请你再等等。

lines.en: : I’m glad that you feel that way about me, but I’m still getting over a broken heart and need time to mend my wings.
lines.zh: : 你对我有这种心意我很高兴，可我还在走出心碎，需要时间养好我的翅膀。

lines.en: : Oh, come on. Even I know not to make my move that early.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，拜托。再怎么说我也不至于这么早就出手啊。

lines.en: scene postbeach10
: That gives away that you’re planning on making a move eventually, you know.
lines.zh: : 这等于承认了你早晚还是要出手的，你知道吗。

lines.en: : I thought that was pretty apparent since the get-go.
lines.zh: : 我以为从一开始这就挺明显的了。

lines.en: scene postbeach2
: You mean you’re fine with me even if I look like this all the time?
lines.zh: : 你是说，就算我一直这副样子你也无所谓？

lines.en: : If you looked like that all the time while seeing me, I’m pretty sure I’d question my validity as a romantic counterpart.
lines.zh: : 要是你跟我见面时一直这副样子，我大概会开始怀疑自己作为恋爱对象的价值。

lines.en: scene postbeach10
: How’s that saying go? If you can’t handle me at my worst, you don’t deserve me at my best?
lines.zh: : 那句话怎么说的来着？受不了我最糟的样子，就不配拥有我最好的样子？

lines.en: : This isn’t your worst. You’re at least able to hold a coherent conversation this time.
lines.zh: : 这还不是你最糟的时候。至少这次你还能说得出连贯的话。

lines.en: : You just look like shit.
lines.zh: : 你只是看起来一团糟。

lines.en: scene postbeach9
: How very kind of you.
lines.zh: : 您真是太体贴了。

lines.en: : Is Haruka not here or something? I figured she wouldn’t let you work in that condition again.
lines.zh: : Haruka 不在吗？我以为她不会再让你这副状态上班了。

lines.en: scene postbeach4
: Uhh...About that.
lines.zh: : 呃……关于这个。

lines.en: : Please don’t tell her this time...I really need the money. I’m still able to do my job, too.
lines.zh: : 这次别告诉她了……我真的很需要钱。而且我也还能干活。

lines.en: : This sad version of Rin is a little different than the last one.
lines.zh: : 这个悲伤版本的 Rin 跟上一次有点不一样。

lines.en: : It’s one thing to experience heartbreak or disappointment or whatever, but it’s a lot different when you don’t know where those feelings are coming from.
lines.zh: : 经历心碎或者失望什么的，是一回事；但当你不知道这些情绪从哪儿来的时候，就完全不一样了。

lines.en: scene postbeach10
: I was able to prepare for this kind of pain, I guess. I’m not being blindsided by my fear of mortality, I just...really like someone who doesn’t like me back.
lines.zh: : 我想，我对这种痛是有心理准备的。我不是被对死亡的恐惧打得措手不及，我只是……真的很喜欢一个不喜欢我的人。

lines.en: I guess she makes a good point.
lines.zh: 她说得确实有道理。

lines.en: She might look like she was dropped from the tenth story of a building in the middle of a thunderstorm but...Well, at least she’s being mature about it.
lines.zh: 她看起来像是被人从暴风雨中的十楼扔了下来，不过……好吧，至少她处理得很成熟。

lines.en: There is still one thing that seems to contradict that, though.
lines.zh: 不过还是有一件事和这说法相矛盾。

lines.en: : If you’re so prepared to deal with these feelings now, what exactly are you hiding beneath your hoodie?
lines.zh: : 既然你现在这么有准备去面对这些情绪，那你帽衫底下到底藏了什么？

lines.en: scene postbeach13
: Umm...
: A crutch?
lines.zh: : 一根拐杖？

lines.en: : There’s obviously no point in lying to you since you’ve figured it out already but...I may have impulsively awakened a bad habit when I came home from the beach.
lines.zh: : 既然你已经猜到了，撒谎显然没意义了，不过……我从海边回来之后，可能一时冲动又唤醒了一个坏习惯。

lines.en: scene postbeach14
: But that’s all it is...A bad habit.
lines.zh: : 可也就仅此而已……一个坏习惯而已。

lines.en: : Just a little kick in the back to say, “Rin, get yourself back into gear. You’re still alive.”
lines.zh: : 就是往背后轻轻踢一脚，说一句「Rin，重新上阵吧。你还活着。」

lines.en: : It’s no different than any other coping mechanism. It’s just leaning on something a little...unconventional to take some of the pain away.
lines.zh: : 这跟别的什么应对机制没区别。只不过是靠着一点……不太常规的东西，来分担一些痛楚。

lines.en: : You are aware that there are plenty of people you can lean on instead, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道有很多人可以作为替代让你依靠的，对吧？

lines.en: : Of course I am. Which is why I’m able to smile while talking to you right now.
lines.zh: : 我当然知道。所以我才能现在笑着跟你说话。

lines.en: : I’m...glad that you care about me. But that doesn’t mean I can just drop habits I’ve had for years.
lines.zh: : 我……很高兴你在乎我。但那不意味着我能把维持了好几年的习惯说戒就戒。

lines.en: Years?
lines.zh: 几年？

lines.en: Has she really been doing things like this for that long?
lines.zh: 她真的做这种事那么久了吗？

lines.en: scene postbeach2
: Hey! How about I take my break a little early and we go sit by the window or something?
lines.zh: : 嘿！要不我早点休息，我们去窗边坐坐什么的？

lines.en: : It would be nice to...get my mind off stuff for a little while.
lines.zh: : 能……让我暂时忘掉那些事就好了。

lines.en: : Do you want something to drink? I’ll actually make you whatever you want this time~
lines.zh: : 你要喝点什么吗？这次我真的给你做什么都行哦～

lines.en: : Nah, that’s fine. You can just make me another one of your weird concoctions.
lines.zh: : 不用了，没关系。你再给我调一杯你那些奇怪的特调就行。

lines.en: scene postbeach15
: Heheh~ You got it!
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿～收到！

lines.en: scene black
I take a seat at a table near the window and watch as Rin starts pumping a few different syrups into a cup.
lines.zh: 我在靠窗的桌边坐下，看着 Rin 往杯子里压进好几种糖浆。

lines.en: She looks a little lost behind the counter, but I imagine that’s more due to lack of sleep than incomparable misery.
lines.zh: 她在柜台后面看起来有点魂不守舍，不过我想那更多是缺觉，而不是无与伦比的痛苦。

lines.en: Before long, another girl takes her place at the register and Rin joins me at the table...
lines.zh: 没过多久，另一个女孩接替了她收银的位置，Rin 也过来和我坐在了一桌……

lines.en: scene postbeach16
: So uhh...Yeah, sorry about the whole beach thing.
lines.zh: : 那个，嗯……是啊，海边那件事对不起啊。

lines.en: : Why would you need to apologize for that?
lines.zh: : 你干嘛为那个道歉？

lines.en: : Because I’m pretty sure I held onto your hand so tightly that it may have turned blue while you were sleeping.
lines.zh: : 因为我敢肯定，你睡着的时候我攥你的手攥得那么紧，可能都把它攥青了。

lines.en: : Small price to pay for making you feel a little more comfortable.
lines.zh: : 能让你舒服一点，这点代价不算什么。

lines.en: scene postbeach17
: I guess, but that still doesn’t mean I can’t feel bad about it.
lines.zh: : 是没错，不过这也并不意味着我不能过意不去。

lines.en: : I didn’t even tell Futaba where I was. Poor girl was worried sick.
lines.zh: : 我甚至都没告诉 Futaba 我在哪儿。那姑娘担心坏了。

lines.en: : How did Futaba even know? Didn’t she go home early?
lines.zh: : Futaba 是怎么知道的？她不是提前回家了吗？

lines.en: : There are other girls in our class, idiot. One of them probably asked if she knew where I was that night when I disappeared into your room.
lines.zh: : 我们班上还有别的女生啊，笨蛋。我那晚消失进你房间，她们里大概有人问她知不知道我在哪儿。

lines.en: scene postbeach18
: Thanks for locking the door to make sure no one could bother us, by the way.
lines.zh: : 另外谢谢你把门锁上，确保没人来打扰我们。

lines.en: : I don’t think seeing me hysterically crying on your bed would have left a good impression on anyone.
lines.zh: : 我想，让别人看到我在你床上歇斯底里地哭，总归不会留下什么好印象。

lines.en: : Yeah, I have enough to deal with as-is. The last thing I need is someone thinking I’m taking advantage of you behind closed doors.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我现在要操心的事已经够多了。我最不需要的，就是有人以为我在关起门来占你便宜。

lines.en: : The last thing {i}I{/i} need is you taking advantage of me behind closed doors.
lines.zh: : 我{i}最{/i}不需要的，才是你在关起门来占我便宜。

lines.en: scene postbeach16
: But I guess even someone like {i}you{/i} wouldn’t stoop that low. You care about me, after all.
lines.zh: : 不过我想，就算是{i}你{/i}这种人也不至于下作到那种地步。毕竟你是在乎我的。

lines.en: if rinbetrayed == True:
: Sure, you might have done the {i}one{/i} thing I asked you not to do, but that doesn’t mean you don’t also think I’m...cool or whatever.
lines.zh: : 当然，你可能确实做了我求你别做的{i}那件{/i}事，但这不代表你不觉得我……很酷之类的。

lines.en: : You’re really not going to let me live that down, are you?
lines.zh: : 你是真不打算让我把这事翻篇了，是吧？

lines.en: : Why would I? It was really fucked up.
lines.zh: : 为什么要？那事真的烂透了。

lines.en: : Friends don’t do that to each other.
lines.zh: : 朋友之间不会那样对彼此。

lines.en: : You really think I can look at you the same way after finding out the girl I spent years fawning over probably pleasures herself while thinking about you?
lines.zh: : 你真觉得，在知道我肖想了好几年的那个女孩，大概会一边想着你一边自慰之后，我还能用同样的眼神看你吗？

lines.en: : Not really an easy thing to forget.
lines.zh: : 这可没那么容易忘。

lines.en: Part of me wants to apologize, but I know it won’t do any good.
lines.zh: 我有点想道歉，可我知道那没用。

lines.en: I never understood why people apologize for things like this.
lines.zh: 我一直不懂人们为什么要为这种事道歉。

lines.en: An apology isn’t just a magic set of words that can make your misdeeds vanish. It draws attention to them.
lines.zh: 道歉不是能让你的过错凭空消失的咒语。它只会把注意力引到那上面去。

lines.en: So it’s best to just ignore things like them entirely.
lines.zh: 所以这种事最好干脆完全无视。

lines.en: else:
: Someone like me? What is that supposed to mean?
lines.zh: : 像我这种人？这话什么意思？

lines.en: : Just that you're a boy. You think with your penis instead of your brain.
lines.zh: : 就是说你是男的。你用阴茎思考，不用脑子。

lines.en: : If I truly thought with my penis, your anti-perversion crying barrier wouldn’t have any effect.
lines.zh: : 要是我真用阴茎思考，你那道「反变态哭泣屏障」就不会有任何效果了。

lines.en: : Ew, you get turned on by crying girls? Pervert.
lines.zh: : 恶，你被哭的女孩勾起性欲？变态。

lines.en: : I’m not a pervert. I’m a man.
lines.zh: : 我不是变态。我是男人。

lines.en: : Same thing. That’s why I like girls more.
lines.zh: : 一个意思。所以我更喜欢女孩子。

lines.en: : They’re only perverted like, 50%% of the time instead of 100%%.
lines.zh: : 她们只有大概 50%% 的时间是变态，而不是 100%%。

lines.en: : I’ll keep that in mind every other meeting we have.
lines.zh: : 我们以后每次见面我都会记住这句话。

lines.en: scene postbeach19
: Umm...Rin? I’m sorry to bother you during your break, but could you help me with this for a second?
lines.zh: : 嗯……Rin？抱歉在你休息的时候打扰你，你能帮我一下吗？

lines.en: : Huh? Yeah, hold on a sec.
lines.zh: : 啊？好，等一下啊。

lines.en: scene postbeach20
: Sorry Sensei, but I’ll be right back...
lines.zh: : 抱歉 Sensei，我马上回来……

lines.en: : It’s fine, actually. I’m probably going to head out now anyway.
lines.zh: : 其实没关系。我大概也准备走了。

lines.en: : I just wanted to stop by and make sure you were doing alright.
lines.zh: : 我只是想过来看看你还好不好。

lines.en: : You scared a few of the girls with the way you left, so I needed to make sure you didn’t go and do something stupid.
lines.zh: : 你那天离开的样子吓到了几个女孩，所以我得确认你没有跑去做傻事。

lines.en: : Well, I did do {i}something{/i} stupid, but not as stupid as what you’re insinuating.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我确实做了{i}点{/i}傻事，不过没你暗示的那种那么傻。

lines.en: : But we can talk more about that soon, okay?
lines.zh: : 不过这个我们回头再聊，好吗？

lines.en: : Futaba and I were probably gonna hang out in our room sometime in the near future and just...talk about stuff if you want to join.
lines.zh: : 我和 Futaba 大概过几天会在房间里待着，就是……聊聊天，你要是想来就来。

lines.en: : I’m sure she wouldn’t mind. It’ll probably all be about me anyway.
lines.zh: : 我肯定她不会介意的。反正大概也都是在聊我。

lines.en: : Are you scheduling your own intervention?
lines.zh: : 你在给自己安排一场干预谈话？

lines.en: scene postbeach21
: It sounded a lot more normal in my head before you put it that way...
lines.zh: : 在你这么说之前，在我脑子里听起来正常多了……

lines.en: : Just come hang out with us. It’ll be fun.
lines.zh: : 就来跟我们待会儿吧。会很好玩的。

lines.en: : Depressing too, I imagine. But also fun.
lines.zh: : 我想也会很抑郁。但也很好玩。

lines.en: : Sounds like a blast...
lines.zh: : 听起来棒极了……

lines.en: scene black
I...apparently make plans to have a depressing, yet fun conversation with Rin and Futaba in the near future.
lines.zh: 我……显然约好了在不久的将来，和 Rin 以及 Futaba 来一场既抑郁又有趣的谈话。

lines.en: I really hope this doesn’t turn out to be one of those ‘group therapy’ sort of things but, if it does, I guess it will be warranted.
lines.zh: 我真希望这不会变成那种「团体心理治疗」之类的东西，不过就算变成那样，我想也是应得的。

lines.en: Rin’s taking this a lot better than I thought she would, so there’s a chance this could just be the calm before the storm or something like that.
lines.zh: Rin 接受这件事的状态比我预想的好得多，所以也有可能是暴风雨前的宁静什么的。

lines.en: I should visit her dorm room whenever I can...
lines.zh: 我应该尽量多去她的宿舍看看……

$ cafe30 = True
{i}Rin’s affection has increased to [rin_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Rin 的好感度提升到了 [rin_love]!{/i}
